inspector.musicSubtitle: Analyze the song and build the shot list
inspector.musicWorkflow: MV workflow — 3 steps: 1) upload music (the tool separates vocals), 2) write the shot list with the master prompt and import one CSV (GPU reads vocals, aligns timecodes and builds both streams), 3) create the performer lineup. Then create images and render as usual.
inspector.musicStreams: One CSV creates two parallel data streams: Stream A covers the song with band shots; Stream B groups sung lines into 7–10 second lip-sync takes. Both streams share one timeline and can be intercut at any second. View the two-lane strip below the canvas; export each stream's CSV from Director step 4.
inspector.musicLyrics: Lyrics exactly as recorded (one line per phrase; include repeats)
inspector.musicLyricsPlaceholder: Paste lyrics, one line per phrase…

inspector.settingDescription.audio: (background/field audio, e.g. low cello drone; no dialogue)
wardrobe.customPromptHint: This node uses its own prompt, so it overrides the description. Use the inherited-prompt action below to switch back to the built-in model sheet.
wardrobe.editDescriptionHint: Edit the description and save; the image prompt is rebuilt automatically.
wardrobe.sheet.prop.hint: The tool builds a prop model sheet with one large main angle and two turnarounds, consistent scale and lighting, plain gray background, no hands or scene.
wardrobe.sheet.prop.empty: If empty, the node name is used as the description.
wardrobe.sheet.character.hint: The tool builds a model sheet with a large portrait and three full-body angles on one baseline, keeping face and wardrobe consistent.
wardrobe.sheet.character.empty: If empty, the tool still builds a model sheet but lets the model invent the person; the node name is not sent in the prompt.
wardrobe.sheet.scene.hint: The tool builds one image with a wide shot and two close angles of the same empty space. Describe the location; no prompt writing is needed.
wardrobe.sheet.scene.empty: If empty, the tool builds a wide scene but lets the model invent the location; the node name is not sent in the prompt.
wardrobe.costumeHint: This node renders the costume on a mannequin and does not accept input images. Create a character-wearing-costume node to combine the person and outfit, then connect that node to shots.

provider.orbitJobHint: The selection is saved per node and attached to each job. The selected profile is opened and the workflow runs. Inputs use mv_input_1_path, mv_input_2_path…; the workflow uploads them and saves the result to mv_output_path.
